<script>function countSeparatedNames(paramsStrArr) {
            // 人员字符串
            paramsStrArr = paramsStrArr.replace(/，/g, "、")
                                            .replace(/,/g, "、")
                                            .replace(/\//g, "、")
                                            .replace(/\\/g,"、")
                                            .replace(/\n/g,"、")
                                            .replace(/、、/g,"、")
                                            .replace(/、、/g,"、");
            var fdNameArr = paramsStrArr.split("、");

            var relCount = 0;
            for (var index = 0; index < fdNameArr.length; index++) {
                if (fdNameArr[index].length > 0) {
                    relCount++;
                }
            }
            
            return relCount;
        }

function updatePeopleCount(paramsStrArr,elementId) {
            var relCount = countSeparatedNames(paramsStrArr);
            SetXFormFieldValueById(elementId,relCount);
        }</script><xform:editShow><script>// 来宾名单变化-计算人数，
        AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_people_text", function(value, domElement){
            updatePeopleCount(value,"fd_people_count");
        });</script></xform:editShow>
<metadata><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_people_text" label="People" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_people_count" label="Count" type="Number"/></metadata>
